Name: Cinematic Events - Immersive Event Camera and Cutscenes
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Cinematic Events[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Dialogue can feel more immersive. Now the world around it can too.[/i][/center]
[center][i]A new way to watch Your favourite Stardew Valley events unfold.[/i][/center]

[center][b]Cinematic Events[/b] gives Stardew Valley's scripted events a more cinematic presentation with smooth camera movement, speaker-focused framing, cinematic zooms, storybook-style perspective and subtle black bars.[/center]
[center]It doesn't rewrite the event or change what happens.[/center]
[center]It simply lets the camera become part of the storytelling.[/center]

[center][youtube]DVFPoMxckvU[/youtube][/center]


[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b]
[b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b]
[b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/size][/color][/center]



[b]🎞️ Cinematic Bars[/b]
Events receive subtle black cinematic bars to help frame the scene.
Dialogue, choices and important UI remain visible above them.

[b]🎬 Let The Scene Breathe[/b]
Stardew Valley has so many lovely little events, but the camera normally stays fairly simple while everything happens around it.
Cinematic Events gives those scenes a little more life.

The camera can naturally switch between different cinematic views during compatible events, smoothly moving toward whoever is speaking and making them the focus of the scene.
This works with:
• NPC speakers
• Your farmer
• Indoor events
• Outdoor events

As the conversation moves from one character to another, the camera gently follows along - without constantly restarting the zoom or making the scene feel jumpy.


[b]🍿Perfect match for DIALOGUE UI UNBOXED[/b]
[b]Cinematic Events[/b] and [b]Dialogue UI Unboxed[/b] were basically made for each other.

Unboxed makes the dialogue itself feel more personal and immersive, while Cinematic Events takes care of the world around it - moving the camera, centering the speaker, changing perspective and giving the whole scene more life.

Together, conversations feel much more [b]immersive[/b] without changing the actual dialogue or event.
You can use either mod on its own, but together they really complete the experience.


[b]💞 Why Cinematic Events?[/b]
I've always loved Stardew Valley's heart events and little character moments, but I wanted them to feel a bit more [b]engaging, emotional and intimate[/b].

When a character is opening up to you or sharing an important moment, I wanted the camera to help pull you into the scene instead of just sitting still in the background.

A closer shot can make a moment feel more personal, and gently moving between speakers can make conversations feel much more alive.
That became [b]Cinematic Events[/b] - the same characters, dialogue and events, just presented in a way that feels a little closer and more cinematic.


[b]🌟 WHAT CINEMATIC EVENTS DOES NOT CHANGE[/b]
Cinematic Events is a presentation mod.
It does not rewrite:
• Vanilla dialogue
• Modded dialogue
• Heart-event scripts
• Dialogue choices
• Friendship outcomes
• Event progression
• NPC choreography
• Story content
Stardew Valley and the event itself remain in control of what actually happens.
Cinematic Events handles the camera presentation around it.


[b]❤️ Special Thanks & Credits[/b]
A special thank you to ElinHime, creator of Handsome Valley, for kindly allowing me to test her beautiful HD portraits during development!

Her artwork was a wonderful way to test and showcase my mod.
If you're looking for beautiful HD portraits for your valley, definitely check out her work!

🖼️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40398][b]Handsome Valley - HD Portraits by ElinHime[/b][/url]

All portrait artwork belongs to its respective creator and is not included. Please download it directly from the original mod page.



[b]📦 REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION[/b]
Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 — tested
• SMAPI 4.5.0 or newer
• Tested with SMAPI 4.5.2
No other mod is required.
Installation
1. Install SMAPI if you haven't already.
2. Download Cinematic Events.
3. Extract the CinematicEvents folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
That's it!
Your next compatible event can now receive cinematic camera direction automatically.


[b]💡 COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Cinematic Events is standalone. It does not depend on any other mods.
Compatible modded scripted events can also receive cinematic presentation when their event structure gives Cinematic Events enough reliable information to safely follow the scene.
Cinematic Events was built with special attention to Dialogue UI Unboxed compatibility.
When both are installed:
• Speech bubbles remain normal foreground UI
• Portraits remain readable
• Dialogue choices remain usable
• The camera follows the actual character, not the speech bubble
• Cinematic bars do not transform the dialogue interface
Both mods also work independently.
Authored Camera Movement
Some Stardew events deliberately control their own camera.
When this happens, Cinematic Events yields control rather than fighting the event.
Once normal compatible dialogue resumes, cinematic direction can return.
Camera Fallbacks
Not every camera angle will be suitable for every moment.
Cinematic Events can safely choose another presentation when a requested shot cannot be used.
These fallbacks are part of the normal camera system and are not errors.
Multiplayer
Live multiplayer is currently unverified.
The mod contains multiplayer-aware safety handling, but I don't want to claim full multiplayer support until it has received proper live co-op testing.

[b]🤖 AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
Cinematic Events was conceived, designed, directed, playtested and approved by me.
Generative AI tools assisted with parts of programming, debugging, testing, technical analysis and development documentation while following the gameplay and visual direction I designed and approved.
The released mod does not run an AI model during gameplay and does not require an online AI service.
Camera selection, speaker detection, framing, transitions, event handling and compatibility behaviour are performed by systems written into the mod.
The mod does not generate dialogue, rewrite Stardew Valley's story or generate new event content during gameplay.
